question: Who among the following received the 'Global Goalkeeper’ Award in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi received the Global Goalkeeper award by the** Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation** for the** Swachh Bharat Abhiyan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Goalkeepers Award** program rewards winners for their **work** and** inspires** more action and innovation at a time when it is **needed most.**

 
 
• The **Campaign Award** celebrates an individual that has **raised awareness** or** built a community** in support of a** Global Goal**-related cause, **inspiring action and creating change. **
